mechanism: per-KV-group learnable orthogonal rotation R_g applied to Q heads of the group and the group K head; continuous QK invariant; V frozen standard
initialization: normalized Sylvester Hadamard H when head_dim is a power of two, else identity; no seed sweep
parameterization: A = Theta - Theta^T; C = (I-A)(I+A)^-1 via linear solve; R = H C; Theta init zeros
forward_encoding: v162 standard HiF4 hard code; STE only for backward: x + (decode(encode(x)) - x).detach()
parameters_per_layer: G * D^D storage; D(D-1)/2 effective DOF per group

research_sampling.selection: deterministic evenly spaced indices, Q rows drawn from the K/V subset

fold_selection: last calibration window in input order is the gate; the others train; no length/effect reordering
training_aggregation: windows equal-weight normalized output loss, heads averaged; each step accumulates the gradient over all training windows
state_selection: final-step learned R only; learned must beat fixed H strictly on the gate, then the winner must beat identity strictly; ties resolve to identity first, then H
training_loss: per window mean((O_hat - O_ref)^2) / max(MSE_STD_window, 1e-12); O_ref = softmax(QK^T/sqrt(D)) V on NVFP4-decoded values; O_hat uses rotated+hard-encoded Q/K and standard-encoded V
dtype: FP32 training; orthogonality and invariants re-checked; non-finite => ERROR (no silent best-step)
research_target: D_strong >= 20 percent mean standardized residual reduction vs strong control, >= 3/4 small-panel layers positive, independent split same sign

gates.mean_delta: > 0 vs v162 and vs direct parent
